title: Recording: #9 Dream, Beef Jerky, Whatever Gets You Thru The Night by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon worked on three songs for his Walls And Bridges album on 23 July 1974.

The first song, ‘#9 Dream’, was a new one. More recording took place on 22 August, and it was completed on 26 August.

‘Beef Jerky’ had been worked on during a 14 July session, but was re-recorded and completed on this day. It was mixed in stereo on 27 August.

The final song was another remake. ‘Whatever Gets You Thru The Night’ had been recorded on 16 and 17 July, but was started again from scratch during this session. The song was completed on 31 July with the assistance of Elton John.
